correctness.rationale: The triangular prism has 264 proper 4-colourings (24 choices for first triangle, 11 compatible lower triples). Character orthogonality and expansion of ∏edges(1-1_{same-colour}) over its 512 edge subsets give an exact integer Fourier multiplier formula for each abelian 4-colour palette. Exhaustive 4096 frequencies in each law yield cyclic abs histogram {0:3072,8:348,24:399,40:198,56:30,72:9,88:39,264:1} and Klein {0:3072,8:408,24:291,40:258,56:18,72:9,88:39,264:1}. Independent direct 4^6 tensor character transforms recomputed both histograms and their moments: M2=264, M4=2044416 common, M6 87824400384 vs 87789010944, difference 35389440. All 4^6 Fourier indices were exhausted, not a sampled extrapolation.
